scope: Read-only decision gate for the two prepared page264 visual cascade fixes. This file does not authorize a WordPress write and creates no CSS replacement by itself.
purpose: Prefer the smallest proven cascade override while preserving the already-live v004/v005 geometry and appearance. Do not weaken the existing both/one/neither deployment gate.

known_static_truth.v006: v004 already declares source-white contact foreground. v006 repeats only the source values with page264-scoped !important and changes no layout/background/spacing property.
known_static_truth.v007: v004 already declares display:grid, repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)), gap:24px and stretch. The freshest post-v005 capture showed unequal target card widths, but the prior evidence did not identify which exact computed declaration lost. v007 strengthens those four root properties plus card width/max-width/min-width and preserves the <=900px one-column contract.
known_static_truth.v005_non_overlap: v005 owns card align-self/height and beige/sage backgrounds only; neither candidate overwrites a v005-owned property.

browser_capability_note: The available Opera connector exposes tabs, accessibility content and screenshots but no JavaScript/computed-style evaluation. Do not claim a winning CSS declaration merely from a screenshot. If a future tool can expose computed style or exact winning rules, use that evidence; otherwise use the existing source-contract candidate rather than inventing an unproven narrower patch.

v006_minimality_gate.fresh_fail_condition: In the same trusted source/target state, the target green contact label/value foreground is still dark while the reference is white.
preferred_extra_evidence_if_available: winning declaration/source for each mismatching color

decision.failure_present_without_property_owner_t: Existing v006 remains an acceptable minimal candidate because it is color-only, page264-scoped and value-identical to the source contract; do not create another CSS variant merely to guess which child rule loses.
decision.failure_present_with_exact_owner_proof: A narrower future artifact may be prepared only if exact evidence proves one of the three v006 declarations is unnecessary. It must not replace the current artifact until separately parser/scope-checked and added to the deploy manifest.

v007_minimality_gate.fresh_fail_condition: At a matched >900px state, source comparison cards are equal width and target cards remain unequal with source-like v005 surfaces/icons/bullets otherwise intact.

cards: bounding width for each direct card

decision.root_grid_wrong: Existing v007 is justified; it restores the exact v004/source root grid contract and neutralizes child width constraints.
decision.root_grid_exact_but_child_constraint_pro: Prepare a new narrower child-only candidate only from exact proof, parser/scope-check it, and update the manifest before using it. Do not hand-edit v007 during the live write.
decision.exact_owner_unavailable_but_failure_repr: Use the existing parser-checked v007 if the normal preflight passes. It is a value-identical strengthening of the source grid contract, does not overlap v005-owned properties, and is safer than inventing an unverified alternative.

cross_component_preserve: Never replay or edit live v004/v005.
Never change page264 Elementor data for v006/v007.
Never change comparison backgrounds, borders, height, icons, bullets, typography or copy from this gate.
Never change request button geometry, background, hover transform, responsive width or MetForm behavior from this gate.
Never use a screenshot-only impression to invent a new property owner.
At most one selected exact repository artifact insertion after the standard both/one/neither fresh gate.
